prompt: The scooter app charges $y = 2 + 0.15m$ dollars for $m$ minutes. How many dollars does a $20$-minute ride cost?
hint: The formula turns minutes into dollars. Use the ride length from the question and take care with the decimal.

hints.text: The formula turns minutes into dollars. Use the ride length from the question and take care with the decimal.

hints.title: 🪜 Try a simpler one
hints.text: Try a ride of $10$ minutes first: $2 + 0.15(10) = 2 + 1.50 = 3.50$ dollars. Now do the same steps with $20$ minutes.
Put $m = 20$ into the formula to get $y = 2 + 0.15 \times 20$. Work out the per-minute part first.
$0.15 \times 20 = 3$ and $2 + 3 = 5$, so the ride costs $5$ dollars.

explanation: Substitute $m = 20$ into the formula because the ride lasts twenty minutes: $y = 2 + 0.15 \times 20$.
Multiply first: $0.15 \times 20 = 3$, since fifteen cents twenty times makes three dollars.
Add the unlock fee: $2 + 3 = 5$, so the ride costs $5$ dollars.

alternativeExplanations.title: Money in pieces
steps: Ten minutes of riding costs $10 \times \$0.15 = \$1.50$, so twenty minutes costs $\$3$.
Add the $\$2$ unlock fee at the start: $\$5$ total.

alternativeExplanations.title: ⚠️ Dodge the trap
steps: Stopping at 0.15 × 20 = 3 forgets the $2 unlock fee that every ride pays.
The rule has two parts: 2 + 0.15(20) = 2 + 3 = $5. Fixed fee plus the per-minute part, always both.
